claims: The NASA Artemis II mission successfully launched from Launch Complex 39B at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The NASA Artemis II mission launched on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
The NASA Artemis II mission launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
The NASA Artemis II mission is a crewed mission to the Moon.
The NASA Artemis II mission lifted off from Florida's Space Coast.
The NASA Artemis II launch was visible across much of Florida.
Artemis II is a Kennedy Space Center mission.
Artemis II is a 10-day lunar journey.
The NASA Artemis II launch location is NASA Kennedy Space Center, Cape Canaveral, Florida.
The NASA Artemis II launch pad is Launch Complex 39B (LC-39B).
Spectators crowded beaches along the Space Coast for the NASA Artemis II launch.
The NASA Artemis II rocket traveled eastward over the Atlantic Ocean.
The NASA Artemis II mission is the first crewed moon mission since 1972.
